orders.name: Orders (regional routing)
orders.policies_xml: <policies><inbound><base /><choose><when condition="@("West Europe".Equals(context.Deployment.Region, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))"><set-variable name="home-backend" value="orders-eu" /><set-variable name="other-backend" value="orders-us" /></when><otherwise><set-variable name="home-backend" value="orders-us" /><set-variable name="other-backend" value="orders-eu" /></otherwise></choose></inbound><backend><retry condition="@(context.Response != null && context.Response.StatusCode == 503)" count="1" interval="0" first-fast-retry="true"><set-variable name="attempt" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("attempt", 0) + 1)" /><set-backend-service backend-id="@((int)context.Variables["attempt"] == 1 ? (string)context.Variables["home-backend"] : (string)context.Variables["other-backend"])" /><forward-request /></retry></backend><outbound><base /><set-header name="x-apim-attempts" exists-action="override"><value>@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<int>("attempt", 0).ToString())</value></set-header></outbound><on-error><base /></on-error></policies>
